title: Soho Smart Ottoman Bed
descriptionHtml:
Storage, sound and charging in one bed. The Soho Smart Ottoman Bed hides Bluetooth speakers behind the fabric of its padded headboard and adds USB charging points on each side, so your phone charges within reach. The gas-lift ottoman base gives you a full bed's worth of hidden storage.

Key features

  • Bluetooth speakers built discreetly into the headboard
  • USB charging points on both sides
  • Gas-lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress
  • Fully upholstered to the floor, no exposed legs

Materials and build

Built on a solid wood frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Needs a nearby mains socket for the speakers and charging. Please ask us about the electrical specification before ordering.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to addresses across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot spills straight away. Switch off at the socket before cleaning around the speakers and charging points.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.
